_notes: Edit only the items inside the events array.
Use dates in YYYY-MM-DD format and times in 24-hour HH:MM format.

Set "month_only": true when you only know the month, not the day. The page then shows the month name (or a span like "May to September" if an end_date crosses months) instead of a made-up date, and the event stays listed for the whole month.
Use internal_url for a page on this website (e.g. /things-to-do/the-talyllyn-railway/) and external_url for the official event website.

Set "locality" to the single town the event is in (Tywyn, Aberdyfi, Machynlleth, ...). It becomes the schema.org address Google requires for event rich results, so leave it out when the event genuinely spans more than one place and it will be left out of the structured data.

Add "tags" to list an event on a seasonal page as well as the main calendar: ["christmas"], ["halloween"] and ["fireworks"] feed /events/christmas/, /events/halloween/ and /events/bonfire-night/. Dates cannot decide this on their own - the Christmas craft fair falls on 31 October, the festive menu runs from mid-November, and the firework displays are spread from Halloween to the second weekend of November.

To give an event its own page on this site, set internal_url to /events/<slug>/ and add src/content/events/<slug>.md (page description + links); the date and location here drive both the calendar and that page.
Most of these repeat every year: roll the dates forward each January to keep the calendar current.
Summaries are our own wording: do not paste descriptions from leaflets or other sites.

_example.title: Tywyn Example Event
_example.summary: A short summary for the event card.

events.title: New Year's Day Dip
events.summary: Start the year with a bracing dip in the sea, as hardy locals and visitors brave the cold to welcome in January.

events.title: Aberdovey Panto
events.summary: A much-loved start to the year, with a family pantomime staged by local performers at Aberdyfi's Neuadd Dyfi.

events.title: Winter Wildlife Walks
events.summary: Guided winter walks through the Dyfi Biosphere, looking out for the wildlife and plant life of the estuary and valley.

events.title: Valentine's at The Magic Lantern
events.summary: A romantic evening at Tywyn's independent Magic Lantern cinema, with themed screenings and a few special treats.

events.title: St David's Day Celebrations
events.summary: Wales marks its national day with parades, music and cultural events in honour of Dewi Sant, the country's patron saint.

events.title: Spring Craft Fair
events.summary: Pick up handmade crafts, art and gifts from makers across the area at this spring fair in Aberdyfi's Neuadd Dyfi.

events.title: Aberdyfi Half Marathon
events.summary: A spring half marathon starting and finishing at Neuadd Dyfi, with a scenic route out along the Dyfi valley.

events.title: Easter Open Day
events.summary: A family-friendly Easter open day at Aberdyfi's RNLI lifeboat station, with the chance to meet the volunteer crew.

events.title: Dafad Goch Soapbox Race
events.summary: Home-built soapbox carts hurtle down Aberdyfi's steep Copperhill Street in this fun and slightly chaotic spectacle.

events.title: Tywyn Light Fest
events.summary: Tywyn's seafront comes alive over two days with light installations, live music and family entertainment on the Promenade.

events.title: Slip to the Brit
events.summary: A fun run along the beach from Tywyn to Aberdyfi, raising money for the Search and Rescue Dog Association.

events.title: Machynlleth Comedy Festival
events.summary: Three days of stand-up in nearby Machynlleth, with a line-up mixing well-known names and rising comedy talent.

events.title: Yarn Bombing Llwyngwril
events.summary: The knitters of Llwyngwril cover their village in colourful, often witty yarn-bombed displays right through the summer.

events.title: Aberdyfi Kite Festival
events.summary: Colourful kites of all shapes and sizes take to the skies above Aberdyfi's wide sandy beach.

events.title: Talyllyn Beer Festival
events.summary: A weekend of real ale, live music and steam trains on the historic Talyllyn Railway.

events.title: Aberdovey Regatta
events.summary: Dovey Yacht Club's flagship sailing fortnight on the Dyfi estuary, opening with a regatta day and continuing with dinghy racing and evening socials.

events.title: Race the Train
events.summary: Tywyn's famous challenge, where runners race a Talyllyn Railway steam train across country between Tywyn and Abergynolwyn.

events.title: Aberdyfi Food Festival
events.summary: A celebration of local food and drink in Aberdyfi, bringing together producers, street food and live music.

events.title: DoveyFest
events.summary: A relaxed community festival around Aberdyfi's wharf, with craft stalls, family activities and live entertainment.

events.title: Tywyn Live
events.summary: A free, all-day celebration of live music on Tywyn's seafront, with a line-up spanning jazz, rock, indie and live beats.

events.title: Tom Rolt Steam and Vehicle Rally
events.summary: A vintage vehicle and steam rally at the Talyllyn Railway in memory of preservationist Tom Rolt, with classic cars, traction engines and veteran transport.

events.title: Barmouth Walking Festival
events.summary: A programme of guided walks exploring the coast, hills and history around nearby Barmouth.

events.title: Talyllyn Railway Heritage Weekend
events.summary: A heritage weekend on the Talyllyn Railway, with period trains and talks on the line's history and its rescue by the writer Tom Rolt.

events.title: Aberystwyth Comedy Festival
events.summary: A weekend of live stand-up across venues in the lively seaside town of Aberystwyth.

events.title: Halloween Crafternoon
events.summary: An afternoon of spooky crafts for younger children at the Trefeddian, part of the hotel's half-term programme by the sea.

events.title: Kids Halloween Disco at The Neptune
events.summary: An hour of Halloween games, music and dancing for little ones in the Neptune's Mermaid Lounge.

events.title: Halloween at the Peniarth Arms
events.summary: Creepy pancake breakfasts for children across the weekend, with free live entertainment and a Halloween night at the pub on the Saturday.

events.title: Halloween Cupcake Workshop
events.summary: Children aged 6 to 12 decorate four Halloween cupcakes to take home, learning a different technique with each one. Places are limited and booked ahead.

events.title: Carnevil Family Halloween Party
events.summary: A family Halloween party at Neuadd Pendre, back for a second year after a popular first outing. Entry is on the door.

events.title: Halloween Fireworks on the Seafront
events.summary: The summer's postponed fireworks finally get their night, rounding off Halloween with a display over the beach once the trick-or-treating is done. The start time is approximate and depends on conditions on the night.

events.title: Christmas Craft Fair at Y Ganolfan
events.summary: An early start on Christmas shopping at Y Ganolfan, with handmade stalls and refreshments. Proceeds are split between the hall and the British Heart Foundation.

events.title: Aberdyfi Bonfire Night
events.summary: The closest big display to Tywyn, on the beach behind the fire station. There is a delicious hog roast and a great bonfire from 6pm, the fireworks start once it is properly dark, and entry is free with buckets going round for the fire service.
events.location: The beach behind Aberdyfi Fire Station

events.title: Aberdovey Christmas Market
events.summary: Aberdyfi welcomes the festive season with seasonal stalls, food, gifts and entertainment.

events.title: Tywyn Christmas Market
events.summary: Festive craft and food stalls in Tywyn, held alongside the town's Christmas lights switch-on.

events.title: Festive Menu at Proper Gander
events.summary: Proper Gander runs a two or three course festive menu through the season, for Christmas meals out, work parties and get-togethers. Larger tables pre-order.

events.title: Tywyn Late Night Christmas Shopping
events.summary: Tywyn's independent High Street shops stay open into the evening for Christmas, with gifts, local makers and cafes open late. A good evening to pre-order Christmas food too.

events.title: Winter Willow Wreath Workshop
events.summary: Weave a willow wreath and dress it with festive foliage in the reserve's tractor shed, with all materials, a hot drink and a mince pie included.

events.title: Glandyfi Castle Christmas Fair
events.summary: The castle's first Christmas fair, with local stallholders and festive trees through the rooms. Tickets are sold in advance.

events.title: Tea With Santa
events.summary: A new festive afternoon at Neuadd Pendre with afternoon tea, Christmas songs, games and a present from Santa for every child. Tickets are pre-booked at Grays Coffee Shop.

events.title: Adventure in Santaland at Plas Dolguog
events.summary: An illuminated evening trail through the grounds, with a storyteller, an elves' workshop, a visit from Santa, artisan stalls and mulled wine.

events.title: Adventure in Santaland at Plas Dolguog
events.summary: An illuminated evening trail through the grounds, with a storyteller, an elves' workshop, a visit from Santa, artisan stalls and mulled wine.

events.title: Santa's Grotto at Layla's Lounge
events.summary: Santa sets up at Layla's Lounge, with a gift and a hot chocolate for every child. Letters posted in the shop's letterbox get a reply before the big day.

events.title: Christmas Day Lunch at Proper Gander
events.summary: The High Street restaurant opens on Christmas Day for a festive lunch, with a limited number of tables.

events.title: Christmas Carol Concerts
events.summary: Community carol concerts and singalongs fill churches across the area through December.

events.title: New Year's Eve Party
events.summary: Ring in the new year with live music and fireworks at Neuadd Dyfi and pubs across Aberdyfi and Tywyn.

events.title: Machynlleth Lantern Procession
events.summary: Handmade lanterns parade through Machynlleth after dark, setting off from Canolfan Owain Glyndŵr and finishing at the football ground. A separate ticketed firework display follows, run by Tân-gwyllt Machynlleth.

events.title: Aberystwyth Fireworks Display
events.summary: The town's annual display at Aberystwyth Rugby Club, run by Ardal Aberystwyth Rotary Club to raise money for local good causes. Gates open at 5.30pm and the fireworks start at 7pm. Entry is ticketed.

events.title: Barmouth Bonfire and Fireworks
events.summary: A community bonfire and pyromusical firework display on Barmouth quay, paid for entirely by donations. A DJ and samba band warm things up from 5pm, the bonfire is lit at 6.30pm and the fireworks start at 7pm.

events.title: Festive Menu at the Railway Inn
events.summary: The Railway Inn at Abergynolwyn runs a festive party menu through the season, with bookings taken for tables of six or more from 20 November.

events.title: Festive Menu at the Penhelig Arms
events.summary: The Penhelig Arms in Aberdyfi offers a three-course festive set menu at lunch and dinner from 9 November to 30 December, except on Christmas Day and Boxing Day, which have their own separate menus. Vegan and gluten-free choices and a festive menu for younger guests are available, and larger parties can ask about group tables or private hire on 01654 767215.

events.title: Christmas Fayre at the Dragon Theatre
events.summary: A one-day indoor Christmas craft and gift fair at the Dragon Theatre in Barmouth, with a mix of stalls to browse for presents. No visitor entry price is published, so check with the theatre before you travel.
events.location: The Dragon Theatre (Theatr y Ddraig), Barmouth

events.title: Aberystwyth Christmas Lights Switch-On and Market
events.summary: Aberystwyth switches on its Christmas lights on Saturday 28 November 2026, with a food and craft market from midday to 7pm along Baker Street and at Capel Seion Vestry. A lantern parade leaves St Michael's at 5.30pm and ends at Owain Glyndwr Square, where the tree is lit; stall details may still change and no admission price is published.

events.title: Barmouth Christmas Lights Switch-On
events.summary: Barmouth's Christmas tree and town lights are switched on by the Mayor on the evening of Thursday 3 December, with carol singing, bells and a samba band on the High Street. Shops stay open late with festive refreshments, children can meet Father Christmas, and many pubs and hotels have live music.

events.title: Tinsel and Turkey Specials
events.summary: Pair a steam train ride from Tywyn Wharf with a festive cooked lunch in King's Café, running on just two Saturdays, 5 and 12 December 2026. Trains leave at 10:30 and 14:10 with lunch served at 13:15, so you can eat before or after your ride, and normal train fares are charged on top of the meal price.

events.title: Dyfi Wildlife Centre Christmas Craft Fair
events.summary: Local makers sell handmade gifts and crafts indoors at the Dyfi Wildlife Centre, open on both Saturday 5 and Sunday 6 December from 11am to 3pm. It is a two-day event this year, up from a single day in 2025, and admission is not stated so check with the centre before you go.

events.title: Pantomime at the Dragon Theatre
events.summary: Magic Light Productions bring a family pantomime to Barmouth's Dragon Theatre on Sunday 6 December 2026, with two performances at 1pm and 5pm. Expect a comic adventure starring Dame Trott and her son Silly Billy against a scheming queen, with plenty of cheering, booing and audience participation.
events.location: The Dragon Theatre (Theatr y Ddraig), Barmouth

events.title: Y Tren Nadolig Fictoraidd, the Victorian Christmas Train
events.summary: A decorated Victorian-style steam train leaves Tywyn Wharf at 11:00 on three Tuesdays only (8, 15 and 22 December), with mulled wine at departure, guides talking through Victorian and Welsh Christmas customs, and a festive cream tea at Abergynolwyn. Fares are £47.50 adult and £23.75 child, the carriages are unheated and not wheelchair accessible, and anyone travelling in Victorian dress gets a £10 voucher on the day.

events.title: Santa Special Steam Trains
events.summary: On the weekend of Saturday 12 and Sunday 13 December, a train rides up the Dulas Valley from Corris to Maespoeth Junction, where children can visit Santa's grotto and collect a present. Tickets must be booked in advance, running times and the locomotive can change on the day, and the railway only accepts cancellations more than 7 days before travel.

events.title: Barmouth Santa Dash
events.summary: Pull on a Santa suit for a relaxed two-mile run, jog or walk along the Barmouth promenade and back, led by the town's Striders running club. It is untimed and family-friendly, with a medal and goodie bag for finishers and a raffle afterwards.

events.title: Tractors with Lights Parade
events.summary: A convoy of Christmas-lit tractors leaves Dolgellau at 17:30 and rolls through Llanelltyd and Bontddu, pausing in Barmouth's Main Car Park for about half an hour before carrying on to Porthmadog. Spectators can watch and take photos for free (no spectator price is published), and the proceeds raised go to charity.

events.title: A Ticket to Christmas at the Vale of Rheidol
events.summary: A steam train ride from Aberystwyth to Capel Bangor and back is followed by a visit to Santa in his grotto at the Engine Shed Museum, where every child gets a present. Tickets are about 25 pounds each (5 pounds for infants) and are booked online or by phone; the railway gives the run as 16 to 23 December but publishes no departure times, so check its booking calendar for the days and times on sale.

events.title: Santa Specials at the Talyllyn Railway
events.summary: Santa trains leave Tywyn Wharf at 11:00 and 14:00 on just four days: Saturday 19, Sunday 20, Wednesday 23 and Thursday 24 December 2026. Each child meets Father Christmas at the end of the ride and gets a gift and a treat, with mince pies and mulled wine included in the ticket (£23 per adult or child, £7 for under-2s and dogs), so arrive at least 15 minutes early.

events.title: The Carol Train
events.summary: An evening steam train leaves Tywyn Wharf at 18:45 for Abergynolwyn, where the carol singing starts, with mulled wine and mince pies served at the station from 18:30 and food and drink at the Abergynolwyn cafe. Tickets are booked through the railway's website (adults £17, children £7, dogs £5), and a charity raffle supports Tŷ Gobaith Children's Hospice.
events.external_label: Book on the Talyllyn Railway site

events.title: The Spirit of Christmas
events.summary: A heated, festively decorated train leaves Tywyn Wharf at midday on Monday 21 December and runs up the Fathew Valley to Abergynolwyn, where a festive afternoon tea is served before the return at about 3pm. Tickets are £45 (£30 for Talyllyn Railway Preservation Society members), booking is essential as places are limited, and the railway pitches it at adults, so check before bringing children.

events.title: Christmas Day Lunch at the Penhelig Arms
events.summary: The Penhelig Arms Hotel in Aberdyfi is taking bookings for a set three-course lunch on Christmas Day, Friday 25 December 2026. Prices and sitting times are not published online, so ring the hotel on 01654 767215 to confirm before you plan around it.

events.title: Christmas Presence
events.summary: The Magic Lantern Cinema opens its doors on Christmas Day for a free community gathering, with a soup lunch, a drink and a mince pie, and a film for anyone who wants to stay. You can drop in between 11am and 3pm, but booking a free ticket in advance helps the volunteer team plan the catering.

events.title: Boxing Day Set Menu at the Penhelig Arms
events.summary: The Penhelig Arms in Aberdyfi is serving a Boxing Day set menu on Saturday 26 December, with a baked mushroom starter, a choice of steak and Malbec pie or salmon en croûte, and a fruit crumble to finish. No price or serving times are published, so ring the hotel on 01654 767215 or book through its website.

events.title: Steam 'n' Scream at the Talyllyn Railway
events.summary: A Halloween meal at Tywyn Wharf followed by a steam train out to Dolgoch Woods after dark. Two sittings each evening, at 4.30pm and 6.30pm, with a two course meal included in the ticket.

events.title: Little Monster Squad
events.summary: An hour of Halloween crafts, games and biscuit decorating for children at King's Cafe on Tywyn Wharf station, finishing with a dance to scare the ghosts away. Five pounds a child including a goodie bag, accompanying adults free, paid at the booking office on the day.
